notes.title: Wonhon: Patch v1.2
notes.notes:
Greetings, ghosts!

First of all, thank you for reporting bugs and sharing your ideas, we value your feedback!
Sean is actively working on new in-game features, which you will surely like to hear about, so let's get to the list of updates and fixes.

[h1][b]Patch v1.2[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]In-game Photo Mode[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Added photo mode that allows players to view the frame from different sides and to be on a lookout for hidden things[/list]

[list][*] Added proton support to the game
If you encounter any bugs or troubles with the build please refer to this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1294340/discussions/0/3035976310915944285/]thread[/url] and report[/list]
More ahead! Just a quick reminder, that we read every feedback we can get, so don't hesitate to write your ideas in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1294340/discussions/0/3069747783694589886/]Feedback Thread[/url].

notes.title: Wonhon: Fix Patch v1.1
notes.notes:
How’s it going, ghosts?

First of all, thank you for reporting bugs and sharing your ideas, we value your feedback!
Before posting a list of fixes, I wanted to remind you that we have created a special [url=https://forms.gle/HLxGZ2rmQG4p3kiD7]Google Form[/url], which we ask you to fill out if you find a bug.
Our QA testers try their best to quickly process all requests and send repeated bugs to the dev Sean for further fixing.

[h1][b]Patch v1.1[/b][/h1]

[h2][b]Steam input controller compatibility[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed bug with incorrect controller input registration when Steam input is enabled[/list]
[h2][b]Mission completion timer fix[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed critical bug in the save/load system that mishandled timer data
This will remove previous incorrect time entries, and shouldn’t affect the game progress. Individual mission timer and full game timer will be affected[/list]
[h2][b]Sound effects volume bug fix[/b][/h2]
[list][*] Fixed bug with certain sound effects not playing while a player is in ghost form[/list]
[h2][b]Hands spawn rate increased[/b][/h2]

The main issues encountered by players after the game release have been fixed.
In case If we missed something important, we sincerely ask you to notify us, since we want to bring the game to its best state, and we can’t do it without your help!
